title: Text: DET Courtney Foyt ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What about Haley, she’s in San Diego for Winter Meetings
Yeah, she’s there
You mean to talk to her?
In terms of
Yeah
Could she provide any useful info/can she be trusted/etc
Uhmmm that is a tricky one. She is loyal to her own leader, but has a lot of issues with the organization. I wouldn’t trust her
Her leader is Ellen, right
When that whole RAP thing happened, she was pissed that Ellen would ever be called into question
And yes, she is her leader
Are you out there?
Yeag
Yeah

Also update- the girl I wanted to talk to that knows weave girl works over at LCA. She pops in CoPa a few times a week, but I haven’t seen her yet and wanted to bring it up in person. I told her I wanted to get dinner this week so should be soon
Enjoy the weather and all the baseball madness out there
